source_text: We report on Quantinuum Helios, a 98-qubit trapped-ion quantum processor.
Helios features all-to-all connectivity enabled by a rotatable ion storage ring.
HRL Laboratories fabricated a highly integrated silicon quantum processor unit encoding 18 exchange-only qubits.
Two independent studies report silicon-based quantum computing chips that can execute basic operations.
Microsoft has unveiled Majorana 2, a next-generation topological quantum chip with 1,000-fold qubit reliability improvement.
MIT researchers designed a new qubit architecture enabling faster and more stable qubit interactions.
Helios operates well beyond the reach of classical simulation, establishing a new frontier of fidelity and complexity.
